then.prompt: Remove a steam counter from Backup Protocol: YEL? (If not, it is destroyed.)

_comment: Identical shape to .drafts/backup_protocol_blu_blue.json with colour yellow. Crank itself is engine-side from the card DB keywords field - not authored. (1) Entry steam counter: TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY + PUT_COUNTER (shipped arc/teklo_core_blue.json pattern). (2) Upkeep: CONDITIONAL(COUNTER_GTE steam min 1) wraps MAY so declining the removal destroys the item (MAY else = DESTROY_SELF) and a zero-counter state also destroys it (CONDITIONAL else); gate deliberately on 'when', not ability-level conditions or MAY-level conditions, both of which would skip the destroy as well. (3) Instant: card-level activation_cost 2 carries the {r}{r} (no PAY_RESOURCES - it would double-charge); DESTROY_SELF ability cost; retrieval is BANISH(from GRAVEYARD, color yellow + class_filter Mechanologist + subtype Attack) + MOVE_REF(hand) because SEARCH_GRAVEYARD has no colour/class filter. Artifact: retrieved card transits the banished zone for an instant (banish events fire on it); net zones match printed text. Empty pool = fail to find, MOVE_REF no-ops.
